name: Standing desk / riser

lead: A standing desk or desk riser raises the work surface so that a person can work on their feet, either permanently or by alternating with sitting. Electric sit-stand desks and tabletop risers are both common.
It is promoted as a way to avoid hours of slumped sitting, which proponents associate with the rounded-shoulder and forward-head look.

paras: Standing reduces sitting time and varies posture, which is the main aim; changing positions through the day is commonly described as mattering more than any one posture. A Cochrane review found that sit-stand desks reduced sitting at work by roughly one and a half to two hours with low-quality evidence, with little evidence on health outcomes.

Prolonged static standing causes foot, leg and back discomfort, and standing only slightly raises energy expenditure. A riser set at the wrong height can create neck and wrist strain. Cochrane authors judged the long-term health effects unproven.
